messages.author: 5d2910e022d63c1b
messages.subject: Error in scan : execution halted
parts:
Hi I am running the following commands and I am getting this error while loading sam files. 


library(methylKit)
file.list <- list("IMR90/GSM432687/GSM432687_sorted.sam","IMR90/GSM432688/GSM432688_sorted.sam","IMR90/GSM432689/GSM432689_sorted.sam","IMR90/GSM432690/GSM432690_sorted.sam","IMR90/GSM432691/GSM432691_sorted.sam","IMR90/GSM432692/GSM432692_sorted.sam")
# read the files to a methylRawList object: myobj
myobj <- read(file.list, sample.id = list("GSM432687","GSM432688","GSM432689","GSM432690","GSM432691","GSM432692"), assembly = "hg18", treatment = c(1,1,1,1,1,1), context = "CpG");



Error in scan(file, what, nmax, sep, dec, quote, skip, nlines, na.strings,  : 
  line 142 did not have 16 elements
Calls: read -> read -> .readTableFast -> read.table -> scan
Execution halted

kindly suggest what might be going wrong

messages.author: 6ac7fce92bcc5d59
messages.subject: Re: Error in scan : execution halted
parts:
Hi,

Please follow these step before running methylkit

BAM -> SAM -> Remove header and sort Sam(<filename>.sort.sam) -> Run methCall.pl (foreach sam file) -> Methylkit Run.

Here is the command to sort sam.
grep  -v '^[[:space:]]*@' <filepath>SRR202003_S.fq_bismark_bt2.sam | sort -k3,3 -k4,4n  > <filepath>SRR202003.sort.sam

methCall Run
perl /usr/local/R-3.0.1/lib/R/library/methylKit/exec/methCall.pl --read1 /home/Dev/Desktop/Methly_test/Methylome-Seq/GSM432690.sorted.sam
--mincov 10
--minqual 20
--type single_sam
--CpG /home/Dev/Desktop/Methly_test/Methylome-Seq/GSM432690_CpG.txt

then you get GSM432690_CpG.txt

Now your script
library(methylKit)
file.list <- list("IMR90/GSM432687/GSM432687_CpG.txt","IMR90/GSM432688/GSM432688_CpG.txt","IMR90/GSM432689/GSM432689_CpG.txt","IMR90/GSM432690/GSM432690_CpG.txt","IMR90/GSM432691/GSM432691_CpG.txt","IMR90/GSM432692/GSM432692_CpG.txt")

# read the files to a methylRawList object: myobj
myobj <- read(file.list, sample.id = list("GSM432687","GSM432688","GSM432689","GSM432690","GSM432691","GSM432692"), assembly = "hg18", treatment = c(1,1,1,1,1,1), context = "CpG");

Make sure your file format of txt file should be as follow

chrBase    chr    base    strand    coverage    freqC    freqT
chr1.91625445    chr1    91625445    F    12    91.67    8.33

Regards
Chandra Deep Tiwari
cdti...@gmail.com, cdti...@hotmail.com

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: Error in scan : execution halted
parts:
It is probably a problem with sam format as Chandra pointed out, certain sorting operations such as Picard might shuffle the order of columns of Bismark sam files. Compare the format of your sorted sam files with the examples in the package:
https://code.google.com/p/methylkit/source/browse/inst/extdata/test.fastq_bismark.sorted.min.sam

Best,
Altuna
